**Missing `workflow_run` trigger violates coding guideline for this file.**

The coding guideline requires that every team in `teams/` (14 teams found) has a corresponding entry in the `workflow_run.workflows` trigger list. This file currently lacks a `workflow_run` trigger entirely, using only a scheduled cron trigger (8:00 and 20:00 UTC).

This changes deployment behavior:
- Deployments are now on a fixed schedule instead of triggered by team performance workflows
- Dashboard updates may be delayed up to 12 hours after a performance workflow completes

Either add the `workflow_run` trigger with entries for all teams in `teams/`, or update the coding guideline to reflect the new scheduled trigger mechanism.
